title: Use two images as the FIRST and LAST frames in Seedance 2.0 to generate a…
content:
Use two images as the FIRST and LAST frames in Seedance 2.0 to generate a 10–15s in-between video.  
Use a prompt structure: Show what happens in between. [CUSTOM action description]. 5 different camera angles. No music.  
Keep Show what happens in between and 5 different camera angles as default prompt clauses, and only change the middle sentence to specify the custom action you want generated.

es.content:
